headline: LAA @ OAK matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 5.93 at OAK 4.34, with a projected total of 10.27. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAA: LAA moved +0.91 runs while OAK moved +0.24, changing the projected margin by +0.66 runs. The projected total climbed +1.00, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: José Soriano has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Zack Gelof, Nick Kurtz, Shea Langeliers, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jeff McNeil because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
